source_caption:
Tulsa King (2022) is a crime drama series starring Sylvester Stallone as Dwight “The General” Manfredi, a New York Mafia capo who is released from prison after serving 25 years. Instead of returning to the life he once knew, Dwight is sent to Tulsa, Oklahoma, by his own crime family to establish a new operation.
In a city where he has no reputation or connections, Dwight quickly realizes that he has to start from the ground up. Rather than letting his situation weaken him, he begins recruiting people around Tulsa and slowly builds a crew of his own. As his operation expands, Dwight finds himself caught between rival criminals, law enforcement, personal relationships, and the expectations of the Mafia family that sent him away.
The series explores themes of loyalty, ambition, power, identity, and redemption. Dwight may be an experienced gangster, but his years in prison have left him disconnected from a rapidly changing world. As he tries to rebuild his influence, he also begins forming unexpected relationships that reveal a more personal side of him.
What makes Dwight’s journey interesting is the clash between his old-school Mafia values and modern-day Tulsa. He is forced to adapt to a new environment while deciding which parts of his past are worth holding onto. His growing empire brings power, but it also creates new enemies and consequences.
More than just a crime story, Tulsa King follows a man trying to reclaim his place in the world after losing 25 years of his life. His journey shows how difficult it can be to rebuild when the people and world you once knew have completely changed.
💬 Can Dwight truly build a new life in Tulsa, or will the choices from his past eventually catch up with him?

source_details.synopsis: Tulsa King is an American comedy and crime drama television series created by Taylor Sheridan for the streaming platform Paramount+. The series stars Sylvester Stallone as Dwight "The General" Manfredi, an American Mafia caporegime who has been recently released from prison in New York and is sent to Tulsa, Oklahoma, where he begins to set up a criminal organization. It is Stallone's first leading role in a scripted television series. The series also stars Andrea Savage, Martin Starr, Jay Will, Max Casella, Domenick Lombardozzi, Vincent Piazza, A. C.
